text: Russia's industrial safety regulator Rostechnadzor (Upper Don Department) investigated the death of a miner in a rock collapse at the underground mine of Yakovlevsky Mining and Processing Plant (Yakovlevsky GOK), part of Severstal, on 30 April 2026. Its commission found that unsatisfactory work organisation, absent supervision of industrial safety and failures of production control caused the death, fined the legal entity 1 million rubles under Article 9.1(3) of the Administrative Code and sent the case materials to law enforcement.
short: Rostechnadzor found that safety violations at Severstal's Yakovlevsky GOK caused a miner's death in April 2026 and fined the company 1 million rubles.

source.name: Abireg (Абирег): Яковлевский ГОК оштрафовали на 1 млн рублей после смертельного несчастного случая
source.quote: Ростехнадзор оштрафовал Яковлевский ГОК на 1 млн рублей за смертельный несчастный случай в апреле 2026 года, вызванный нарушениями в организации работ и надзоре за безопасностью.
source.note: Translation: Rostechnadzor fined Yakovlevsky GOK 1 million rubles over a fatal accident in April 2026 caused by failures in work organisation and safety supervision. The article states Yakovlevsky GOK 'входит в Северсталь' (is part of Severstal).

additionalSources.name: Rostechnadzor, Upper Don Department (official): completed investigation into the fatal accident at Yakovlevsky GOK
additionalSources.quote: Верхне-Донское управление Ростехнадзора завершило расследование несчастного случая со смертельным исходом 30 апреля 2026 года на опасном производственном объекте «Рудник подземный» ООО «Яковлевский ГОК» в посёлке Яковлево Белгородской области.
additionalSources.note: Translation: the Upper Don Department of Rostechnadzor completed the investigation of the 30 April 2026 fatal accident at Yakovlevsky GOK's underground mine. The notice adds that the legal entity was fined 1 million rubles and the case materials went to law enforcement. Severstal lists Yakovlevsky GOK among its company assets at severstal.com/eng/about/structure/businesses/.
